title: The Clock
poemText: Like lovers always missing each other
They draw the circle of time
Beginning and end joy and sorrow
They are the masters of our lives
The silent witnesses of our days
Is a small death a small birth
In the small space of the house.
longCaption: Morning card revealed. The Clock measures time differently: not by hours, but by what remains in us.

title: The Memory of a Wall
poemText: I have felt the backs of hiding lovers
I have heard secrets whispered low
I have borne the weight of war posters
They wrote words of love and hate upon me
I am the skin of the city
and if you press your ear against me
the echo of all the hearts
shortCaption: Morning card prepared: The Memory of a Wall.
longCaption: A wall remembers more than a city admits: lovers, war posters, children's drawings, and the old echo of human hearts.
